notes.title: 👻A Halloweeny Patch👻
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This is just a small update that aims to better balance the Halloweeny Halloween mode.

It contains:
🎃 A new special upgrade!
🎃 The SpellShot Damage upgrade has been increased from 2 damage to 4, and now can be purchased as many times as you want. 

Oh, and also an updated / revised version of the Halloweeny Soundtrack! Now sounds bigger, and better. 😎

and finally, thank you to everyone who continues to play!

tags.balance_change: 🎃 The SpellShot Damage upgrade has been increased from 2 damage to 4, and now can be purchased as many times as you want.

notes.title: 🎃👻A HALLOWEENY HALLOWEEN UPDATE👻🎃
notes.content:
👻[b]BOO![/b]👻
The eerie season is upon us once again (arguably the best time of year) and you know what that means.

[b]Spookta [/b]has awakened from his crypt and is ready to snatch candy from not just children, but goblins, ghouls, and all manner of ghostly creatures lurking in the night.

But beware... Spookta isn’t the only thing that's been resurrected from the shadows…

[b]THIS NEW PERMANENT UPDATE BRINGS:[/b]

[b]--NEW MAPS--[/b]
Every level has a completely redesigned map to explore and play around in!

[b]--NEW MODE--[/b]
A spine-tingling [b]HALLOWEENY HALLOWEEN MODE[/b] has crept its way into the main menu! Play as Spookta, the dread reaper of candy corn, wielding a cursed new weapon. Battle waves of nightmarish monsters (and the occasional brave trick-or-treater) under the haunting moonlight.

Can you collect enough candy corn before you’re devoured by the darkness?

[b]--COMPLETE RESKIN--[/b]
The entire game has been reskinned in the Halloweeny Halloween mode exclusively! Not a trace of Christmas was left behind. 

[b]--NEW SPOOKY SOUNDTRACK--[/b]
A bone-rattling, MONSTROUS new soundtrack pulses through the Halloweeny Halloween Mode, so prepare for Spookta to bring the terror with some heavy beats!

THE SONGWRITER (Marshall Weiss) CAN BE FOUND HERE: [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/41MFUBoeSFbv8AiylFZr25?si=0Qhe3AdfT06cna0ttZUTew]Marshall's Spotify[/url]
Go check him out!

[b]--ALSO FEATURING--[/b]

🎃 Two Bewitching New Upgrades!
🎃 Ghastly New Achievement!
🎃 Spine-chilling New Mouse Cursor!
🎃 Creepy QoL Changes!

notes.title: First Major Update! A Christmassy Christmas 2.0!
notes.content:
[b]It is time for... the First Major Update![/b]
There is plenty of new content to discover!

[b]Includes:[/b]
- Steam Achievements!
- Time Limit Increase from 6 minutes and 30 seconds to 10 Minutes in the base game!
- Endless Mode Changes.
- 3 New Meta-Upgrades!
- A New Enemy Type!
AND
- [b]A New Boss....[/b]

I hope you enjoy! Please report any bugs found in the discussions section in the game's community hub. 
Thanks for playing!
